content.value: Suppose that you are asked to design an alarm circuit which will be operated as follows: (12)
"The alarm will ring if the alarm switch is turned on and the door is not closed, or the time is between 6 PM and 6 AM and the window is not closed."
Show the design of this combinational circuit in detail.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
